# Map: st-stm32-usart-v1 → uart 1.0.0

Compatible: st,stm32-usart, st,stm32-uart  
Manual: RM0410 Rev 5 section 34 (USART), STM32F76xxx/F77xxx  
Features: base, dma, inversion
